entities.summary: The Daya Bay Reactor Neutrino Experiment was a China-based multinational particle physics project studying neutrinos, in particular neutrino oscillations. The experiment operated in 2011–2020. The multinational collaboration includes researchers from China, Chile, the United States, Taiwan, Russia, and the Czech Republic. The US side of the project is funded by the US Department of Energy's Office of High Energy Physics.
